summary: @beckyjo17 Desperate for rain in Northeast. Isaias didn't drop a bit of rain and still lost power for eight days. Praying for the Gulf Coast to make it through this season. We can't handle a catastrophic storm now.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@beckyjo17 Desperate for rain in Northeast. Isaias didn't drop a bit of rain and still lost power for eight days.

Praying for the Gulf Coast to make it through this season. We can't handle a catastrophic storm now.
